svg.title: Business Revision workflow state
svg.desc: A first successful Check-in moves a Revision from Start to In Work. Submit moves it to Under Review. Reject or Withdraw returns it to In Work. Approval records a decision but the Revision remains Under Review until an eligible Release succeeds. Checkout never changes this workflow.
